title: AgentFlow — Runners
description: Gateway command spans, runner command spans and offline events.

widgets.title: Gateway command spans by compute target

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.compute_target_id'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name IN ('gateway.command_event', 'gateway.command_ack') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Gateway command errors by compute target

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.compute_target_id'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name IN ('gateway.command_event', 'gateway.command_ack') AND has_error = true AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT attributes_string['af.operation_id'] AS operation, count() AS calls, countIf(has_error) AS errors, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_nano) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-runner' AND name LIKE 'runner.command%' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY operation ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 100

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.operation_id'] AS label, quantile(0.95)(duration_nano) / 1e6 AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-runner' AND name LIKE 'runner.command%' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(toInt64(timestamp)) AS time, attributes_string['af.compute_target_id'] AS compute_target_id, trace_id FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body = 'compute_target.offline' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
